jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Company Description
Humana is a healthcare company focused on helping members achieve their best health by delivering personalized, simplified, whole-person healthcare experiences. As healthcare needs evolve for individuals, families, and communities, Humana develops innovative solutions and resources that empower people to live their healthiest lives on their own terms. The organization prioritizes customer-centric care and relies on dedicated employees whose experience and passion drive these efforts. Humana will never require candidates to pay for work equipment or network access during the application process, and encourages applicants to verify any suspicious requests by contacting yourcareer@humana.com.
Role Description
The Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator is a full-time, on-site role based in California, United States. This position supports senior leaders through calendar management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and document preparation. The role involves tracking project timelines, organizing logistics, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure deliverables are met. The Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator may assist with inspection schedules, status reporting, and follow-up on action items to keep projects on track. This role also requires maintaining confidentiality, prioritizing multiple tasks, and providing proactive administrative and coordination support in a fast-paced environment.
Qualifications

Experience as an Expeditor with strong expediting skills to manage timelines, materials, and project milestones.
Demonstrated Project Management capabilities, including planning, coordination, and monitoring of project tasks and workflows.
Knowledge of Inspection processes and procedures, with the ability to support scheduling, documentation, and follow-up activities.
Background in Logistics Management, including coordinating resources, managing schedules, and supporting operational efficiency.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities and deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of reports, presentations, and professional correspondence.
Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, calendar and project tracking software).
Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders while maintaining a high level of professionalism and discretion.
Prior experience in healthcare or a similarly regulated environment is beneficial.
Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Peer Counselor Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary And Responsibilities

As our Peer Counselor Program Coordinator
, you will plan, coordinate, implement, and evaluate breastfeeding peer counselor programs for the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC), designed to promote maternal and infant nutrition literacy, breastfeeding education and support, and individual and community wellness, working directly with pregnant and breastfeeding mothers in the WIC community.

Every day you will collaborate with community partners and external organizations to coordinate breastfeeding promotion events and programs, oversee the work of WIC Breastfeeding Peer Counselors, and serve as a liaison between WIC participants, healthcare providers, and other support agencies, developing strategies and resources in conjunction with community agencies, high schools, and groups in accordance with grant provisions.

To be successful in your role, you will need strong organizational, communication, and computer skills, including database management, along with independent and critical thinking, creativity, and discretion to navigate varied and evolving work situations.

Plans, coordinates, implements and evaluates the grant-funded breastfeeding peer counselor program in accordance with grant provisions and requirements.
Participates in identification of community health promotion needs and development/implementation of promotion activities related to WIC breastfeeding education and support.
Designs/develops health activities/tools for WIC communities/groups to effectively meet breastfeeding promotion needs.
Recruits community organizations for partnering on breastfeeding and maternal and infant nutrition education initiatives.
Collaborates on program marketing efforts including flier development, PowerPoint presentations, social marketing, etc.
Participates in development of grant applications and assists with data input, analysis and quarterly/annual reporting; attends training, meetings and other events hosted by granting agencies.

Job Requirements

Required

Bachelors Other in Health Education/Promotion or related field and two (2) years’ experience in community outreach, program planning and evaluation, upon hire and
one years’ experience providing breastfeeding support or
Five (5) years’ experience in health education and/or public health or community outreach, with experience in nutrition, physical activity, food justice, prevention programming, planning and evaluation or related experience and
one year experience in providing breastfeeding support and
International Board Certified Lactation Consultant, upon hire

Where You'll Work

Virginia Mason Franciscan Health has a rich history of providing exceptional healthcare, dating back to 1891. Building upon a legacy of compassionate care and innovation, our organization has evolved over the years through strategic partnerships and integrations to expand our reach and services across the Puget Sound area.

Today, as Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, we remain deeply committed to healing the whole person – body, mind, and spirit – in the communities we serve. This commitment is strengthened by the diverse expertise and shared values brought together through our growth.

Our dedicated providers offer a full spectrum of health care services, from routine wellness to complex disease management, all grounded in rigorous research and education. Our comprehensive network of 10 hospitals and nearly 300 care sites strategically located across the greater Puget Sound region reflects our ongoing commitment to accessibility and comprehensive care.

We are proud of our pioneering medical advances and numerous awards and accreditations that reflect our dedication to excellence. When you join Virginia Mason Franciscan Health, you become part of a team that delivers top-quality, professional healthcare in modern, well-equipped facilities, and contributes to a legacy of service built on collaboration and shared purpose.

Pay Range

$29.44 - $48.57 /hour

jobs.title: Data Analyst | AWS Cloud | PostgreSQL
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career, collaborate with talented colleagues around the world, and help leading organizations unlock the value of technology in a more sustainable and inclusive way.

About the Role

Capgemini is seeking a Data Analyst
to support a strategic Financial Services engagement. This role will focus on enterprise data solutions, ETL/ELT development, data analysis, reconciliation, and data warehouse initiatives within an AWS cloud environment.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Aurora PostgreSQL, Oracle, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and data quality management
.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and support ETL/ELT processes for enterprise data solutions
Write and optimize complex SQL queries and transformation logic
Perform data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality activities
Create and maintain logical and physical data models
Support enterprise data warehouse and data integration initiatives
Work with PostgreSQL, AWS Aurora PostgreSQL, Oracle, and AWS cloud technologies
Troubleshoot data quality, performance, and integration issues
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to define data requirements and solutions
Support testing, production support, and release activities
Document data flows, mappings, and technical specifications

Required Qualifications

6-10 years of experience in Data Analysis, Data Integration, Data Engineering, or related disciplines
Advanced SQL development and query optimization skills
Strong PostgreSQL experience
Experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL
Experience working in AWS cloud environments
ETL/ELT development and support experience
Data modeling and data management experience
Experience with Oracle databases
Enterprise data warehouse experience
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

Financial Services industry experience
Experience supporting BI and reporting solutions
Data governance and data quality experience
Experience with cloud-based analytics and data warehouse platforms

What You'll Bring

Strong expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and enterprise data environments
Experience with data validation, reconciliation, and quality management
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality data solutions
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams

No sponsorship available. Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of employment without current or future visa sponsorship.

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Life at Capgemini:

Capgemini supports all aspects of your well-being throughout the changing stages of your life and career. For eligible employees, we offer:
• Flexible work
• Healthcare including dental, vision, mental health, and well-being programs
• Financial well-being programs such as 401(k) and Employee Share Ownership Plan
• Paid time off and paid holidays
• Paid parental leave
• Family building benefits like adoption assistance, surrogacy, and cryopreservation
• Social well-being benefits like subsidized back-up child/elder care and tutoring
• Mentoring, coaching and learning programs
• Employee Resource Groups
• Disaster Relief

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The Program Coordinator
serves as the first point of contact
for all individuals exploring Habitat’s Homeownership Program. This position proactively manages inquiries, provides initial program education, and plays a critical role in recruiting prospective partner families.
The Program Coordinator ensures that every interested household receives timely, accurate information through a 1-1 phone call and guides interested people into the appropriate next step—towards homeownership-whether that is attending a workshop, being referred to an outside partner, Road to Readiness or moving directly into the application pipeline. The Program Coordinator will carry out the work while exemplifying the Indy Habitat values.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

(Primary duties; other responsibilities may be assigned.)
Front‑Line Customer Engagement

Serve as the primary point of contact
for all program inquiries via phone, email, voicemail, in‑person visits, walk‑ins, and follow‑ups with recently declined applicants.
Works to ensure that the weekly goals are met for 1-1 meetings with interested people. To ensure goals are met, this position will need to proactively reach out to leads that have completed the information session and also provide reminders for scheduled meetings.
Provide clear, accurate information about Habitat’s Homeownership Program, future areas of building, eligibility criteria, readiness expectations, and next steps.
Ensure each prospect is triaged appropriately—into readiness counseling, an information session, follow‑up communication, or application consideration.

Outreach and Community Connection

Represent the Homeownership Department at outreach events and neighborhood based activities. These events are often on evenings and weekends and require flexibility.
Promote and host information sessions about first time homeownership to cultivate interest in the Habitat program and to support goals for 1-1 meetings.

Data Management & Pipeline Tracking

Manage databases for all incoming inquiries, ensuring accurate tracking, documentation, and hand‑offs to the appropriate team members.
Track internal statistics related to leads, information session completions, and movement through the early pipeline after the 1-1 calls.
Maintain organized inquiry data that feeds into recruitment metrics and departmental reporting.

Compliance & Organizational Support

Work with the Program Manager and Lending Manager to ensure compliance with state, federal, and Habitat mortgage‑related guidelines
.
Demonstrate excellent customer service, professional communication, and mission‑driven engagement with prospective homebuyers and community stakeholders.
Perform other duties as assigned in support of departmental operations

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional nights and weekends.
Knowledge of federal, state, and Habitat requirements related to mortgages and homeownership.
Excellent verbal, analytical, and written communication skills.
Strong customer service mindset with the ability to work professionally with diverse populations.
Detail‑oriented, deadline‑focused, and highly organized.
Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; database management experience is a plus.
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. when supporting events or community activities.
Maturity, sound judgment, strong problem‑solving skills, and strategic thinking.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE & CREDENTIALS

Spanish fluency preferred.

3-5 years Credit experience required.
3-5 years Mortgage experience required.
College degree required.
Database management experience preferred.
Three to five years of industry
‑ related experience
, preferably in homeownership counseling, mortgage lending, credit counseling, or similar fields.

·        Credit and mortgage experience required
.
·        Experience with Salesforce or other CRM systems is a plus.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Regular use of telephone, computer, and communication tools.
Ability to perform job duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

ACCOUNTABILITY AREAS

Program inquiries.
Community outreach participation.
Database Management, Mailers, info sessions, and neighborhood engagement.

Show more

Show less

Entry level

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Other

Industries

Non-profit Organization Management
